questions.prompt: Which of these are kinds of poem?
questions.fact: A haiku is seventeen sounds long. A fresco is painted into wet plaster and a sonata is played, not written down as verse.

questions.prompt: Which of these are gods in Norse myth?
questions.fact: Anubis is Egyptian, Marduk Babylonian and Perun Slavic. Every mythology has a thunder god; only one of them has Thor.

questions.prompt: In what year did the Titanic sink?
questions.fact: April 1912, on its first voyage, from Southampton to New York.

questions.prompt: How many episodes of Friends were made?
questions.route: Ten series of about two dozen episodes each.
questions.fact: 236, over ten series. The last one was watched by more than fifty million people in the United States.

questions.prompt: In which sport would you use a foil?
questions.hint: There are three blades in the sport, and this is the lightest.
questions.fact: Fencing has three weapons: foil, epee and sabre. The foil is the lightest and only counts hits to the torso.

questions.prompt: Which nut is marzipan made from?
questions.hint: The same nut as amaretto and frangipane.
questions.fact: Ground almonds and sugar, and nothing else in the traditional recipe. It is older than the sugar trade in Europe.
